FastQC-viz: Creat all help

Source: R/add_all_help.R
add_all_help.Rd

When creating the replacement list for fill the HTML template file, use this to add help sections. It creates keys for "help_" to each module.

Usage

add_all_help(add_help)

Value

list, list with all the "help_" keys for plots and headers.

Examples

add_all_help(add_help = TRUE)
